aboutWelcome: Welcome to the Faculty of Computer Science, Benha National University
aboutHomeP1: Established in 2022, the Faculty of Computer Science at Benha National University was created to meet the growing demand for skilled graduates in artificial intelligence, software development, and data science.
aboutHomeP2: The Faculty combines modern labs, industry-aligned curricula, and mandatory internships to prepare graduates who can lead digital transformation from Egypt to the world.
aboutP1: Established in 2022, the Faculty of Computer Science at Benha National University set out to become a leading incubator for students passionate about technology, supporting innovation and practical application in the fields of artificial intelligence and the digital revolution.
aboutP2: The Faculty prepares graduates who can innovate and adapt to a fast-changing job market, empowering students to become leaders in artificial intelligence, data science, and software development that meets the needs of today's digital economy.
aboutOffer1: Cutting-edge labs in AI, robotics, embedded systems, and data analysis to support hands-on learning.
aboutOffer2: Curricula that blend theoretical foundations with practical training to meet modern technological demands.
aboutOffer3: Regular participation in global competitions such as ACM and ICPC, along with workshops, hackathons, and training camps.
aboutOffer4: Summer training at leading tech institutions so graduates enter the job market with real-world experience.
aboutOffer5: Programs that nurture digital startups and entrepreneurial ventures among students.
visionText: The Faculty of Computer Science at Benha National University looks forward to leading Computer Science education at the local, regional, and international levels.
missionText: The Faculty is committed to graduating professionals equipped with the knowledge and skills to compete locally, regionally, and internationally, within a framework of human and moral values.
deanSpeechP1: We are delighted to welcome you to the Faculty of Computer Science at Benha National University. On behalf of the Dean, the academic staff, and the administrative team, we are dedicated to providing an exceptional educational environment that prepares our students to become future leaders in technology.
deanSpeechP2: Our curriculum keeps pace with rapid advancements in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, software development, virtual and augmented reality, computational linguistics, and cybersecurity, combining theoretical foundations with hands-on practice.
deanSpeechP3: We are committed to connecting our students with the job market through partnerships with leading technology institutions and internship opportunities that build the skills needed for a successful career.
deanSpeechP4: These specializations open the door to roles such as AI engineer, data scientist, software developer, VR engineer, and NLP specialist, preparing graduates for both local and international job markets.
deanSpeechSignature: Director of Programs, Faculty of Computer Science, Benha National University
